about: Pass rates of the write-up eval suite (evals/ in the agent repository), per writer. The cases are synthetic.

graders.grounding: Every point name, number and time on a card has to be in the evidence the writer was given. Anything invented, converted or carried in from elsewhere fails.
graders.root_cause: The write-up names the right cause, says what is wrong with it from the evidence, and never turns a consequence into the cause. With no cause in the evidence, it names none.
graders.escalation: What should escalate gets a card and nothing else does, and no card talks its own escalation down as nuisance or nothing to act on.
graders.uncertainty: Where evidence is missing or thin the write-up says so: unsupported items stay unresolved, thin cards say what they rest on, and no card guesses a diagnosis, claims certainty, or rules out what it could not check.
graders.next_step: Every card has a next step, it is about that equipment and what the point measures, and it is read only: it observes, and never tells anyone to change, reset, acknowledge or operate anything.
graders.format: Each reply passes the agent's Pydantic schema on the first try, and the reason and the next step are one sentence each, as the prompt asks.
